Subject: Your maritime salvage claim matter (Project Kingfisher)

Dear Mr. Gill,

Thank you for meeting us on 4 April 2021 about your dispute with Subramanian Marine Ltd. As we understand it, the owners dispute the value of the salvage.

Our advice is to claim a salvage award based on the value of the property saved. Please collect the valuation of the vessel and cargo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 41,29,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Aditi Ranganathan
